faqs.question: How long does flea treatment take to work in New Brunswick homes?

faqs.question: Are flea treatments safe for pets and children in New Brunswick?
faqs.answer: Yes, we use EPA-registered products that are safe for pets and children when applied correctly. We recommend keeping pets and children away from treated areas for 2-4 hours after application until surfaces are dry, then they can safely return to treated spaces.
